verdict.rationale: The only source-related evidence is a public GitHub repo for the Terminal JS SDK (stripe/terminal-js) and a public OpenAPI spec repo, so some client-side code and API definitions are readable. Nothing shows the core Terminal service, reader software, or other SDKs being available, and no license is stated anywhere. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license, source for the core product and reader software, and source for the Android/iOS/React Native SDKs.
